name: io.github.mindstone/mcp-server-things
title: Things 3
description: Read Things 3 lists, projects and areas on macOS; optionally add, update and complete to-dos

environmentVariables.name: THINGS_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to offer the tools that add, change and complete to-dos (off: read-only)

environmentVariables.name: THINGS_ALLOW_TRASH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1, with THINGS_ALLOW_WRITES, to offer moving a to-do to the Trash

environmentVariables.name: THINGSDB
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Things main.sqlite to read instead of the one found automatically
